Abba Kabir Yusuf, under his Kano First Agenda, is the true definition of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s Renewed Hope Agenda in action.
Suleiman stated this in Kano yesterday during the official working visit of the Minister of Works, His Excellency, Engr. David Umahi, to commission landmark projects in the state.
According to him, the Minister’s visit provided an opportunity to showcase several critical infrastructure projects executed by the administration of Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf, including urban roads, flyovers, and strategic interchanges within the Kano metropolis.
Speaking during the visit, Suleiman expressed amazement at the scale, quality and speed of delivery, describing the governor’s achievements as unprecedented since assuming office.
“What Governor Abba has done in Kano is unprecedented. In less than three years, he has transformed Kano. This is not just governance; this is performance at its peak. The Kano First Agenda is working, and it is giving our people real hope,” Suleiman said.
He noted that the quality and durability of the projects meet the highest engineering standards of the Federal Ministry of Works, adding that Governor Abba has proven to be a strong believer in President Tinubu and a reliable partner in the Renewed Hope project.
“When you see this level of performance, you know this governor believes in Mr President. He is delivering the dividends of democracy and translating the Renewed Hope vision into reality for the people of Kano. This is true progressivism,” he added.
He further stated that all the achievements recorded by Governor Abba are inspired by President Tinubu’s Renewed Hope blueprint, reiterating that the Kano State Government remains fully aligned with the President’s vision for a greater Nigeria.
“Our Kano First Agenda is our own way of domesticating Mr President’s Renewed Hope Agenda. Mr President has given us direction, and we are following that path. We are strong believers in Mr President, and we will continue to support him to succeed,” Suleiman stated.
He therefore appealed to the people of Kano State and Nigerians at large to continue to support the All Progressives Congress, APC, during and after the elections, stressing that the APC remains the only party with a clear vision and commitment to deliver sustained development, peace and prosperity for the nation.
The colourful commissioning ceremony was attended by the Minister of Works, top federal and state government officials, party leaders, traditional rulers and thousands of enthusiastic Kano residents.
